title: Minimum Edit Steps
statement: A spelling tool may insert a character, delete a character or replace a character, each as one step. Find the minimum number of steps to turn the first word into the second.
input_format: Two lines, each with a word of lowercase letters (a word may be empty).
output_format: Print the minimum number of steps.

examples.explanation: Replace k with s, replace e with i and insert g: 3 steps.

hints: Think about the answer for every pair of prefixes of the two words.
Each cell depends on three neighbours: insert, delete or replace (free when the letters match).
Only the previous row is needed at any time, which keeps memory small.
